newsitem.title: CANADA: Celanese Canada declares methanol force majeure.
newsitem.headline: Celanese Canada declares methanol force majeure.

text.p: Celanese Canada Inc said on Friday it declared a force majeure on shipments of methanol and derivatives from its Edmonton, Alberta facility after several "unavoidable" shutdowns at the end of September.
Celanese, an affiliate of Hoechst AG, said the Edmonton unit was functioning at full capacity and the force majeure allocation to customers was expected to end in mid-October.

The methanol derivatives include formaldehyde and pentaerythritol. The unplanned shutdowns were not expected to have a "significant" impact on earnings, it said. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
